patch.summary:
Choose Bright Data only if your buying job matches “Web data / proxy platform — pay-as-you-go from ~$4/GB residential; starter commitments fro” rather than incident.io's shape. Choose incident.io only if your buying job matches “Incident response — Basic Free; Team $15/user/mo annual ($19 monthly); Pro $25/user; on-ca” rather than Bright Data's shape. Workflow advantage: Bright Data leans web-data-collection; incident.io leans incident-oncall. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Bright Data is Web data / proxy platform — pay-as-you-go from ~$4/GB residential; starter commitments from ~$499/mo.; incident.io is Incident response — Basic Free; Team $15/user/mo annual ($19 monthly); Pro $25/user; on-call add-on +$10–$20/user. Does not outrank PagerDut.
- Company-size focus: Bright Data (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs incident.io (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Bright Data-leaning web-data-collection vs incident.io-leaning incident-oncall.
- Researched limits: Bright Data — GB/commitment pricing is opaque without live calculator — medium pricing confidence; incident.io — On-call paging is an add-on (+$10–$20/user), not included in the $15 Team floor.

Limitations — Bright Data: GB/commitment pricing is opaque without live calculator — medium pricing confidence; Compliance and acceptable-use rules must be validated per project; incident.io: On-call paging is an add-on (+$10–$20/user), not included in the $15 Team floor; Does not outrank PagerDuty (8.0) as the incident-oncall award.

Poor-fit cases: Bright Data is a poor fit when that limitation bites: GB/commitment pricing is opaque without live calculator — medium pricing confidence · incident.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: On-call paging is an add-on (+$10–$20/user), not included in the $15 Team floor · Avoid Bright Data if you actually need incident.io's motion (Incident response — Basic Free; Team $15/user/mo annual ($19 monthly); Pro $25/u)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
